title: Signup necessary before seeing prices
body: With such a steep price (€229.99/year) it’s an immediate uninstall for me. Even worse because they make you sign up with your email address before showing the subscription options.
author: Leozock

title: Content meh - price insane
body: The app definitely got a great intention, but the price tag for what you get is seriously ridiculous
author: Benedikt-2014

title: Absolutely trivial ‘insights’, no refund even though promised
body:
If you’ve done just a tiny bit of research on ADHD and coping mechanisms, this app does not offer anything new. Its contents are nothing but summaries of trivial ‘tips’ such as time boxing packaged into a gamification framework.
Note that even though a generous refund policy is advertised during the signup process, the fine print includes a clause that you must not have used the app to be entitled to a refund (yeah …)
author: xf___

title: This is just a joke..
body: Why are you guys milking individuals who suffer from a illness?! An illness that cost the people suffering a lot of money, even if they don’t pay for this high priced app.
author: Patrick_Fitzpatrick
